head.title: Açaí Raiz | Coffee made from the açaí seed, produced in Sergipe
head.desc: We turn the açaí seed into coffee and cacao and coffee blends. Organic family farming in Sergipe, with domestic and international shipping.

hero.titulo:
The coffee made

from the açaí seed.
hero.sub: Bring a new way of enjoying açaí to your business: natural, innovative, and surprising.
hero.ctaPrimario: I want to be a partner
hero.xicaraAlt: A cup of açaí seed coffee, with beans and seeds around it

numeros.sub: Growing production, with partners in Brazil and abroad.

essencia.desc: Rich in bioactive compounds, açaí, coffee, and cocoa combine flavor with natural properties that make them special ingredients. We harness this potential in new products, highlighting their benefits and utilizing each ingredient in a more conscious and sustainable way.

cafe.desc: Energy to start the day differently.

cacau.desc: Intense flavour, naturally rich in antioxidants.

acai.desc: Whole-fruit use, from the berry to a new product.

produtos.sub: Three versions made from the açaí seed, all in 250g packs, ground and ready to brew.
produtos.trioAlt: The three 250g packs of the Açaí Raiz range

cafe-grao.desc: 100% roasted and ground açaí seed. Caffeine free, with a woody flavour and reddish colour.

blend-cacau.desc: Açaí with pure cocoa. More intense in its sweet aroma and naturally rich in antioxidants.

blend-cafe.desc: Açaí with arabica coffee. Keeps the caffeine of coffee with the smooth body of açaí.

origem.desc: Three or four lines about the farming families, the organic management and the whole-fruit use.

fotos.familiaAcaizal: Two generations of the family holding freshly harvested açaí bunches in the grove
fotos.familiaTerreiro: A grower and a child showing bunches heavy with açaí in the farmyard

fotos.visita: A group of farmers gathered on a visit to the açaí grove
fotos.equipe: The agricultural extension team gathered at the farm

colheita.desc: The açaí is hand-picked, respecting the fruit’s natural cycle and taking care of the land.

caroco.desc: After the pulp is extracted, the seed is separated and repurposed, giving a new use to an essential part of the fruit.

torra.desc: The seed is carefully roasted using an artisanal process, transforming the fruit into a drink with a unique flavor, aroma, and character.

envase.desc: Once prepared, the product is carefully packaged and shipped directly from our family production to your business.

um.citacao: It's quite unique and has a lot of benefits; I'm drinking it instead of coffee because of the caffeine. I recommend it!

dois.citacao: You can really see all the respect and care you have for the fruits of the land. I love your products and can't live without them.

tres.citacao: My customers buy from curiosity, wanting to try a product that is completely different from what they're used to.
